summary: Minnesota Forest Service 81-ft Aermotor ladder tower, dated 1927 or 1928; sold and removed in 1981. The site later became a landfill and transfer station.

facts.status_note: Sold and removed in 1981; the site later became a landfill and then a transfer station

access.note: The former site is at a transfer station; the writer's visit to the site was made with staff permission

corrections.why: 140N-30W-6 is a township, range and section code for the location, not an agency; the Cass County table lists Mn MFS as owner.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Cass County table gives 1927; its note says the Aermotor tower was erected in 1928. The story reports both and leads with the table date.
The kjackson.us page calls the spot a gravel pit in one place and a sand pit in another; the story reports both, as the page does.

sources.title: Birch Lake, Historical Minnesota Fire Towers

notes_for_editor: Removal in 1981 is stated by two lists (Cass County table and A-Z list). The build year conflicts (1927 table vs 1928 note). The record's agency field held a legal land code (140N-30W-6); corrected to Mn MFS as owner. The kjackson.us page is the only source on the site today; it is an individual's visit report, and the visit was made with transfer-station staff permission. Access level 'permission' rests on that one visit; the page does not say whether the public may enter. Height 24.7 m is 81 feet converted.
